What does "skilled, focused managers" mean in this context? Based on the domain knowledge, I see these relevant categories:
1. "Focused Alpha Leader" = Alpha Generator (5-year alpha > 0) + High-Conviction Portfolio (largest holding > 8%)
2. "Elite Active Manager" = Consistent Outperformer + High-Conviction Portfolio
3. "Alpha Generator" alone = 5-year alpha > 0

Which definition should I use, or is there a specific combination you mean by "skilled, focused"?

result: The term "skilled, focused managers" refers to funds that are "Focused Alpha Leaders". This means they have a 5-year alpha greater than 0 and their largest holding constitutes more than 8% of the portfolio.
